objectives.primary: Improve both supplied-eight equal-benchmark macro pass@1 and pass@8 over original under identical frozen benchmark generation/grading.

objectives.user_aspiration: Beat comparable original/control scores across every supplied benchmark, on both pass@1 and pass@8.
objectives.claim_rule: Improving the macro alone is not beating every benchmark. Report all16 per-task metric deltas and every regression; claim universal improvement only if actually observed, with uncertainty qualified.
